scope: 15 distinct recipes compared, plus a tenkasu technique reference; failed fetches are excluded from the count.

recipes.title: Serious Eats — crispy roast potatoes
recipes.method: Alkaline simmer and roughened potato coating; oven finish.
recipes.decision: Explains the user's remembered method. Use only a small optional soda dose for narrower fragile wedges; this roast recipe is not a source for frying times.

recipes.title: Smoked BBQ Source — triple-cooked potato wedges
recipes.method: Parboil, fluff surfaces, dry/freeze and fry in stages.
recipes.decision: Closest match to the requested shape and roughening. Keep the fryer temperatures explicit rather than using a highest-setting instruction.

recipes.title: J-Simple Recipes — potato tempura
recipes.method: Raw 5 mm slices, flour dusting, cold batter, 170 °C oil.
recipes.decision: Thin raw slices work; its short cooking schedule cannot be applied directly to 15 mm raw wedges.

recipes.title: Idaho Potato Commission / Tiffani Faison — crispy chili potatoes
recipes.method: Poach small potatoes until tender, cool, dust with cornstarch, coat with packaged tempura mix and fry at 350 °F for 4–5 minutes.
recipes.decision: Primary basis for precooked potato tempura and use of packaged mix. Adapt shape to narrow wedges and seasoning to oregano/basil; packet hydration takes precedence over this source's particular mix ratio.

recipes.title: Charlotte Fashion Plate — crispy potato wedges
recipes.method: Par-cooked wedges in buttermilk and flour/cornstarch, single fry at 177 °C.
recipes.decision: Useful heavier Jojo alternative, but more breading than the requested potato crust or light tempura.

recipes.title: Cooking with Smita — crispy potato wedges
recipes.method: Parboiled wedges with rice flour/plain flour batter and Italian herbs.
recipes.decision: Supports herb-flavoured battered wedges; lacks measured oil temperature, so not the basis of the frying schedule.

recipes.title: CopyKat — Jojo potatoes
recipes.method: Seasoned flour and buttermilk coating; discusses oregano/basil variations.
recipes.decision: Heavier fried-chicken-style coating; retain the herb idea, choose a lighter shell.

recipes.title: Sanjeev Kapoor — potato wedges
recipes.method: Parboiled wedges with cornstarch, basil, thyme and oregano; air-fryer finish.
recipes.decision: Seasoning comparison only; air-fryer timings do not transfer to deep frying.

recipes.title: This Silly Girl's Kitchen — fried red potato wedges
recipes.method: Two oil stages around 160 °C and 190 °C for waxy red potatoes.
recipes.decision: Shows an oil-only double fry. Choose floury potatoes for a lighter centre; its first stage is not the simmer-plus-130 °C method.

recipes.title: Jamie Oliver — potato wedges
recipes.method: Lengthwise wedges, parboil, oil and roast.
recipes.decision: Shape and parboiling comparison; oven timing excluded from deep-fryer instructions.

recipes.title: Nicky's Kitchen Sanctuary — crispy potato wedges
recipes.method: Floury potatoes, parboil, roughen, cornstarch and roast.
recipes.decision: Supports floury potato choice, drying and roughening; extra cornstarch is unnecessary for the selected bare-potato crust.

recipes.title: Epicurious — crispy spiced potato wedges
recipes.method: Half-inch Russet wedges, simmer until tender, chill, flour/cornstarch/buttermilk coating and fry at 350 °F.
recipes.decision: Supports slender precooked wedges and cooling for handling; omit heavy dredge in the main method.

recipes.title: Sanjeev Kapoor — crispy Parmesan potato wedges
recipes.method: Parboil, flour coating, freeze, deep fry; cheese and parsley added after frying.
recipes.decision: Make-ahead comparison; freezing is not required for the same-day recipes.

recipes.title: Cookipedia — triple-cooked chips
recipes.method: Simmer, dry/chill, first fry at 130 °C, cool again, hot finishing fry.
recipes.decision: Basis for separating cooking, crust-setting and final browning. Our 185 °C finish and 15 mm wedge timings are adaptations, not verbatim Heston instructions.

recipes.title: Chef JA Cooks — Japanese sweet potato tempura
recipes.method: Thin sweet-potato slices and a simple egg-free flour/water batter.
recipes.decision: Batter comparison only: sweet potato and ordinary potato have different cooking behaviour.

supplementary.title: Just One Cookbook — tenkasu / agedama
supplementary.finding: These are already-fried scraps of batter, distinct from dry batter mix and from panko; use as a finishing topping rather than frying the scraps again as a coating.

selected.crispy-potato-wedges: 500 g floury potatoes, 15 mm wedges, simmer to tenderness, gentle roughening, thorough drying/chilling, 130 °C first fry 5–7 minutes, chill, 185 °C second fry 3–5 minutes; season after frying.
selected.potato-wedge-tempura: Same slender cut; simmer without soda, leave surface intact, cool/dry, dust with starch, coat in packet tempura batter, fry once at 170–175 °C for about 4–5 minutes; season after frying.
selected.timing_policy: All durations are guides. Tenderness, surface dryness, oil recovery, crust colour and a hot centre are the deciding checks. These synthesized recipes have not been kitchen tested.
